_comment: ngsolve plasticity#2 (return mapping as a per-integration-point Newton, iteration count mesh-independent, quadratic). Observed 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604 with power-law hardening and ngsolve.fem.NewtonCF on meshes of 14/54/224 elements: the smallest maxiter giving a non-NaN result is the same on all three, the residual history r_k+1/r_k^2 stays near 2e-5 (quadratic), and after convergence the area fraction with |sigma_vm - Y| > 1e-10 is exactly 0.0 on every mesh. Under-iterating NewtonCF returns NaN, its documented failure signal. MUTATION CONTROL (re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 raises MAXITER_WRONG from 4 to 20, i.e. the local NewtonCF solve is given enough iterations to converge -- the documented fix at the pathology site.
